12. Why is conversion of Ethanol to ethanoic acid an Oxidation reaction?                          [2] 
Ans: Since the conversion of Ethanol to ethanoic acid involves the addition of oxygen to ethanol 
it is an Oxidation reaction. 
13. Write the electronic configuration of nitrogen atomic number 7 and phosphorus atomic 
number 15.Which of these will be more electronegative?                                       [2] 
Ans: Electronic configuration of nitrogen atomic number 7= 2, 5 
 Electronic configuration phosphorus atomic number 15= 2,8,5
